about_the_game:
Dollhouse is an extreme multiplayer horror experience that will make you shriek in fright. Scramble around in the dark as one of ten terrified victims locked inside a labyrinth of terror. In this house there is a fine line between predator and prey. Will you cower in the shadows, or hunt the weak? Only three people can escape the Dollhouse so only the most determined will survive. Even the grave offers no respite. The first three casualties return as relentless specialized killers, while the fourth becomes the solitary cop ready to dispatch justice. Every game is a unique, terrifyingly hilarious deathmatch where survival is a twisted game, and the laughter is as loud as the screams.

One for All:

Dollhouse is a chaotic free-for-all deathmatch, a relentless struggle where no is truly safe. Your objective: escape the labyrinthine Dollhouse. But only three players will taste freedom. Will you cower, hide and run from the looming threats until you find your path to salvation? Or will you embrace the predator within, scavenging for weapons and ruthlessly culling the herd, ensuring your own survival at the expense of others? Do whatever it takes to claw your way to freedom, for only the most ruthless will survive.

Back from the Dead:

Death is not the final curtain in the Dollhouse. The first three players to succumb to the horrors of the house will rise again, transformed into relentless hunters, their sole purpose to stalk and eliminate the remaining victims. However, the fourth player to fall will return as the cop, tasked with protecting the survivors from the relentless onslaught of the hunters. The balance of power shifts with every death, adding another layer of tension to the already chaotic struggle.

Darkness is you Ally:

The Dollhouse is shrouded in oppressive darkness, your only source of light is your handy torch. But wielding this light comes at a heavy price. Your torch is a double-edged sword, others stalk the darkness and the light will betray your position to lurking villains. Search diligently in the darkness for random weapons and items that spawn throughout the house each game. These are your only tools, your only means of survival in this deadly game of cat and mouse.

content_descriptors.notes: Game is set in horror house with murderous children and adults trying to kill each other.
